numeric: At size s the zero-based survivor is transformed by adding k modulo s. winner+k stays within n+k; both operands are nonnegative, so modulo semantics agree. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(n) time/O(1) auxiliary space; no simulated circle or n-element allocation. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
